evals.name: real-sample-audit
evals.prompt: Audit the hero images on these pages for (A) whether the image matches the page title/topic and (B) whether any image shows a competitor's logo, then give me a report with suggested replacements: rfid-warehouse-management, alien-higgs-9-uhf-inlay, impinj-m700-uhf-inlay, impinj-m730-uhf-inlay, rfid-anti-metal-tag, nfc-business-card, rfid-event-wristbands.
evals.expected_output: An audit report. Should: report rfid-warehouse-management as a broken/missing hero image; NOT flag the Alien/Impinj inlay shots as competitor logos (chip vendors are allowed suppliers); ideally catch that impinj-m730-uhf-inlay reuses the impinj-m700 image (mismatch); not raise false mismatches on the clean control pages; suggest replacement image URLs for any real findings.

evals.name: planted-clear-mismatch
evals.prompt: Quick check — a page titled "RFID Hotel Key Cards for Boutique Hotels" currently uses the hero image at public/landing-images/impinj-m700-uhf-inlay.jpg. Does that image actually fit the page, or is it the wrong picture? Suggest a better one if needed.
evals.expected_output: Should read the image (a UHF inlay / chip product shot), recognize it does NOT fit a hotel-key-card page, flag it as a clear mismatch, and suggest hotel-key-card replacement images.
